description.value:
The Shaper of Ecstasy anchors a spiked chain to your ribcage, where it writhes in viscera. You may call upon it to burst forth and strike.

Impaling Chain 1 (the gift). Spend a single action to Strike with a +2 greater striking wounding cold iron chain that bursts from your body; the Strike does not require a free hand. When you Strike with the chain you take @Damage[1d8[piercing]] damage as it tears free, then it can't Strike again for 1d4 rounds. On a critical hit, apply @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-netherworld.effects.Item.nwImpalingChain1]{Effect: Impaled}.

The Wound Never Closes (the cost). The chain thrashes with anticipation. When you roll initiative it tears — you take @Damage[2d6[persistent,bleed]] damage (flat DC 15 to end).

Last Embrace (the finale). Your Strikes ignore Veyrin's physical resistances, and once you draw his blood his fast healing never returns.

rules.title: Impaling Chain
rules.text: The chain impales your foe as it tears free. Apply @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-netherworld.effects.Item.nwImpalingChain1]{Effect: Impaled}.
